description:
Toshi Densetsu Series is a series story about Urban Legend Japan parodyed with passion and sexuality that makes you will not feel afraid anymore with the name of a ghost or a demon.

Episode 1 - Toilet no Hanako-san
The story is based on the Japanese ghost legend of "Hanako in the Toilet" where this story begins from Hasegawa Hanako, an elementary school student who wants to put a love letter in the afternoon when the class is over. However, suddenly she was raped by the teacher PEDOPHILE, Hanako accidentally died raped and thrown in the men's toilet. At night, there was a young teacher who was sent to school and he heard a voice from the Toilet then he found Hanako, from where the story will begin ....

Episode 2 - E-noroi no Video
This story tells about the curse of the horror movie or the famous Urban Legend is Sadako. Because of technological advances and world developments, Sadako is beginning to be forgotten and she loses the power to be her ghost. To restore her strength, she had to make a new promotional video by debuting a porn video with a man she had just met after she left the TV.

Episode 3 - Hachishaku-san
This story tells about the legend of Hachishaku-sama is a god who lives in a village, but over time many people walk forget it. Then, she tried to wander off to a place to meet the kids. It is said that this Hachishaku-sama legend has a height of 2m 40cm or as its 8-foot-tall, adult-shaped name and likes to appear in front of the boys and eat it, but they usually eat in the pervert stuff like the penis.

Episode 4 - Mary-chan no Denwa
This story tells the story of the legend of the beautiful Mary-san dolls being thrown into the trash can and begins to take revenge on people by terrorizing it over the phone. But this story has been parodyed by Mary-chan who called a virgin man and took her virginity with the heavenly sensation of him.

Episode 5 - E-noroi no VR
Continue on the story of Sadako. Now Sadako has switched habitat, previously she from Television, now moving to Virtual Reality (or VR) game. Convert, create, manipulate VR Games into real sex games.

Episode 6 - Shuuketsu Erokawa Kaii
Continue again in the story about the Toshi Densetu Series ghosts. Now Hanako's ghost is depressed, she feels depressed because she feels disappointed living as a ghost who cannot unite with living things like humans and animals. She wanted to help an abandoned cat and adopt it but she realized that she was a ghost and could not live with living things. Then Sadako asked for help with other ghosts Mary and Hachishaku to make Hanako cheerful again.

(Source: Translated and Edited from Nekopoi)
